newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET - NITE SERIES SEMI CARRIED OVER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - NITE SERIES SEMI CARRIED OVER.

text.p: The Nite Series semi-final between Northern Transvaal and Western Province was abandoned due to rain at Centurion Park on Sunday. The teams will meet at the same venue for a new game on Monday.

Western Province scored 230 for seven in their 45 overs after winning the toss. Jacques Kallis top-scored with 86 from 106 balls with four fours and a six. Fanie de Villiers was the pick of the bowlers with three for 41 in nine overs.
Northerns scored 30 without loss from 4.3 overs before rain forced the game to be abandoned.

The draw for the final was made with the result that, in the event of Northern Transvaal beating Province, they will play Natal at Kingsmead in the first leg on Friday (a day/night game), with the second and third legs at Centurion on Sunday and Monda (day games).

If Province beats Northerns they will host Natal at Newlands on Friday (day/night) with the next game at Kingsmead on Sunday (day game). If a third leg is required it will be at Kingsmead under lights on Tuesday.
